title: Status-Verified Tiers at Renewal — Northgate Student Club and Heroes Club
content:
Northgate Student Club Membership and Northgate Heroes Club Membership are the two discounted tiers of Northgate Memberships.

## 1. Basis of the discount

Student Club and Heroes Club memberships are discounted on the strength of a verified status.

## 2. Verification on record at renewal

A Student Club or Heroes Club renewal keeps its tier only when the status verification on record is valid on the first day of the new membership year. The verification on record is the date through which the verification is valid, as shown on the membership; it is valid on a day when that date is the same day or later.

| Verification valid through (hypothetical) | First day of the new membership year | Valid on that day |
|---|---|---|
| 30 June 2027 | 30 June 2027 | Yes |
| 30 June 2027 | 1 July 2027 | No |

## 3. Source of verification

Verification results come only from the status-verification partner. Each successful result sets the date through which the verification is valid to the day before the same calendar date the tier's verification validity period (in calendar months) later. A member's own statement of status is never recorded as verification.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a successful Student Club verification returned on 15 March 2026, with a 12-month validity period, is valid through 14 March 2027.

## 4. After a conversion

Once a renewal has converted the membership, the membership stays at the converted tier from then on; a later verification does not restore the discounted tier.

## Retired clauses — no longer in force

- "A Student Club membership also keeps its tier only while the count of its Student Club membership years is below the tier's discounted term limit." — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis.
- "When either condition fails, the renewal is taken at the tier's conversion tier and charged that tier's annual fee" — **no longer in force**; superseded by the current basis.
